title: Behavioural interviews, and an answer that is structured without being a script

videos.script: Tell me about a time you had a conflict with a colleague. Tell me about a mistake you made. Tell me about something you are proud of. {{q}} These are behavioural questions, and they appear in almost every process, often in the same interview as the technical part. {{appear}} They are asking for a story, and they are judging it on what you did, not on how well you tell it. {{story}} This lesson gives the story a structure, builds a small bank of real stories before the interview, and deals with the two questions everybody dreads: your weakness, and a failure.
